slots_and_copies.name: header_block0

checksums.name: block_checksum_logical_1
checksums.formula_detail: acc=0; for i in 0..2047: acc=((acc+data[block_start+i])&0xFFFF)^0xFFFF; stored u16_le. KH is K>>16 of the code constant ((acc+byte)*0x10000 ^ K)>>16 in FUN_08001a9c/FUN_08001b5c; KH=0x7FFF is functionally identical at this even covered length (see report 4.3).

checksums.name: block_checksum_logical_2
checksums.formula_detail: Same recurrence as block_checksum_logical_1 over the full 2048-byte block buffer (live struct is only first 0x4A0 bytes; trailing buffer bytes are zero in samples and still covered).

checksums.name: block_checksum_backup_1
checksums.formula_detail: Same recurrence over physical block 5 at 0x2800; stored in header table[5]. Writer stores the same value as table[1] from the same buffer checksum.

checksums.name: block_checksum_backup_2
checksums.formula_detail: Same recurrence over physical block 6 at 0x3000; stored in header table[6].

Block writer: primary+backup (slot and slot+4, 0x800 each), updates header table entries, rewrites 0x28 header.

DMA RAM copy. In save path only via FUN_080149e0 (deserialize block2 0x4A0 out) and FUN_08014a10 (serialize block2 0x4A0 in); other callers non-save.
DMA setup helper; prepares 0x800 buffer in FUN_080019ec. Never addresses SRAM.
Wrapper: FUN_08001b5c(1, block1 buffer) with no DMA staging.
Wrapper: DMA 0x4A0 live struct -> block2 buffer, then FUN_08001b5c(2, buffer). Caller is textual-only (callgraph omits).
Wrapper: FUN_08001a9c(2, buffer), then DMA 0x4A0 buffer -> live struct.

open_questions: Exact RAM mirror addresses (EWRAM/IWRAM) of the block1 buffer, block2 buffer/live struct, and header buffer: decompiled.c only has unresolved _DAT_0800xxxx literal-pool symbols; values are not in this workspace.

Gameplay semantics of block1 fields (intra 0x24/0x3E/0xA5/0xCF/0xF5/0xF9/0xFF scalars, 0x120/0x160 paired 32-entry arrays, 0x180 identity array, 0x1D1, 0x200-0x22D span, '725' at intra 0x2FD, 0x400 sparse 256-entry table, 0x680 u16 region) - one populated sample cannot name them.

Block2 record semantics beyond structure: 8 records x 0x94, name at +5 (CP932), record0 u16 list at +0x22, tail bytes at +0x62/+0x82; whether records are decks, slots, or another list, and the name-field true width/terminator.
Top-level triggers of FUN_08001a44/08007e34/08007e4c/08014a40/08008394: no callers in callgraph.json or textual decompiled.c; entry is via UNRECOVERED_JUMPTABLE dispatch.
Whether physical blocks 3,4,7-15 are used by code outside the 200-function corpus.

Bit 15 and low 16 bits of the checksum ROM constant (_DAT_08001be4/_DAT_08001b30): low bits provably discarded; bit15 is functionally irrelevant at the fixed even covered length 2048 (0xFFFF vs 0x7FFF identical on all inputs tested including random blocks).
FUN_08014a40's cleared RAM byte (_DAT_08014a58+0xFE): which buffer it aliases cannot be resolved from symbols or samples.
